§ IV[ How we work ]
NOFOG MACHINE.
01/04
// i
Say what you actually do
The site should explain the business faster than the owner can over coffee. If it needs a philosophy page to make sense, it is not done.
02/04
// ii
Useful beats impressive
Sharp design matters, but the job is not to look expensive. The job is to help the right person trust you enough to start a conversation.
03/04
// iii
Fix the funnel, not the vibes
We care about forms, calls, rankings, cost per lead, follow-up, and whether anyone can tell what happened after launch.
04/04
// iv
Automate after the process is real
AI is useful when the workflow is already understood. We do not automate confusion; we clean it up first, then make the repeatable parts faster.
